changed_expectations.reason: Families with an able agent now carry 'available:<agent>' and absent families 'no_agent_configured' instead of being omitted (which produced 'no capacity evidence supplied'); agent_can_take_task is patched because the bare config has no agent definitions.

runtime_budget: No recurring job or persistent writer added; exception record stays one entry per other family with reasons capped at 120 chars; one bounded git log (30s timeout) per worker_process_missing recovery.
activation: Live only after the supervisor runtime promotion. Accepted when a real reassignment on the promoted runtime shows other-family reviewer preference or incumbent-pair retention.
reopen_fixes: Reviewer-role lost-lease recovery orders candidates cross-family first; incumbent-retention readiness flags gated on recovery role; capacity evidence aggregates every agent of a family (an available agent wins, otherwise reasons are joined, capped at 300 chars before the 120-char per-reason cap in the exception record).
